name: wechatpy-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is wechatpy, a Python SDK for the WeChat Official Account platform, WeCom (WeChat
Work) and WeChat Pay. This task covers its callback layer and the core of its active-call client: parsing of
pushed messages and events, rendering and deserializing passive replies, callback signature checks and message
encryption for official accounts and WeCom, the utilities and session storages, and the WeChatClient request and
access-token handling with its JS-SDK, media, menu, message, misc, QR code, semantic, tag, template and user APIs.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the Python modules wechatpy/__init__.py, wechatpy/constants.py, wechatpy/events.py, wechatpy/exceptions.py, wechatpy/fields.py, wechatpy/messages.py, wechatpy/oauth.py, wechatpy/parser.py, wechatpy/replies.py, wechatpy/schemes.py and wechatpy/utils.py, everything under wechatpy/crypto/ and wechatpy/session/, the modules wechatpy/work/__init__.py, wechatpy/work/crypto.py, wechatpy/work/events.py, wechatpy/work/exceptions.py, wechatpy/work/messages.py, wechatpy/work/parser.py and wechatpy/work/replies.py, the modules wechatpy/client/__init__.py, wechatpy/client/base.py, wechatpy/client/api/__init__.py and wechatpy/client/api/base.py, and the client API modules wechatpy/client/api/jsapi.py, wechatpy/client/api/media.py, wechatpy/client/api/menu.py, wechatpy/client/api/message.py, wechatpy/client/api/misc.py, wechatpy/client/api/qrcode.p
